Shares of most Tata Group ​stocks
fell on Friday, a day ‌after Shapoorji Pallonji Group ​proposed
selling a portion of ⁠its stake in holding company Tata Sons for
at least ₹25000 crore.
As of 9:40 am, Tata ‌Chemicals tumbled as much as ‌7.8%, ⁠while Tata Investment ⁠Corporation fell 3.9%. Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles dropped 2.6% and Tata Power lost 1.4%.

Shares ​of Tata ‌Steel were down 0.15%, Tata Motors
fell 0.48% and Tata Elxsi slipped 1.09%,
while Tata ‌Capital rose 1.1%.

The declines reversed ​some of the gains made by Tata ⁠Group stocks on Thursday, after Tata Sons reappointed N. Chandrasekaran as chairman ‌for another five years and decided to consider a public listing.

Tata Trusts on Thursday said that Shapoorji Pallonji Group,
Tata Sons' second-largest shareholder, ‌had proposed monetising a
portion of ​its stake in the holding company.

The proposal includes ⁠a share buyout in two tranches ⁠over 18
months that would yield proceeds of ‌at least ₹25000 crore
to the SP Group.

title: Tata Group stocks fall after SP Group unveils ₹25,000 crore stake sale plan
